name: GLOBE Cultural Dimensions
excerpt: GLOBE Cultural Dimensions explore various cultural attributes and leadership behaviors.
notes: GLOBE Cultural Dimensions explore various cultural attributes and leadership behaviors, including power distance, uncertainty avoidance, institutional collectivism, in-group collectivism, gender egalitarianism, assertiveness, performance orientation, and humane orientation.
